name: Glitch Hop
description: Neon precision platformer: dodge spikes and saws, wall-jump and spring through 65 hand-built levels, chase 3 stars and Glitch mode.
market_notes: Precision platformers (Super Meat Boy, Geometry Dash-likes) have a loyal mobile audience and strong replay via stars/hard mode, but the genre is crowded and needs polished levels, skins and more content.
readiness_notes: Core physics (coyote, buffer, variable jump, wall jump, pads), 65 bot-verified levels, touch+keyboard controls, one-tap touch restart, Continue progression shortcut, live level-progress and checkpoint HUDs, live normal-mode PB lead/deficit speedrun HUD, exact par-budget and missed-time-star guidance, in-run next-star guidance, normal clear replay-goal/MASTERED feedback, exact pause-run recap for informed mobile resume/restart, separate Glitch-mode PB/death records, Daily mode isolated from normal records, clearer world mastery and accessible level-select status, cause-specific death coaching, corruption-safe local save normalization, screen-reader game-state announcements, pressed-state semantics, keyboard focus handoff across overlays, HTTP(S) cache-first service worker with direct-file fallback, SFX/music, save, stars, independent mastery best times and lowest death records, hard mode, ad hooks, icons, skins. Missing: human playtest tuning, art polish, store assets.

changelog.summary: Created game: physics engine, 10 levels verified by beam-search bot, touch controls, SFX/music, stars, Glitch mode, icons.

Coin-unlocked skins (5, cycle button in menu), coin total on menu, best-coins keeps max
World 3: phase blocks (pink/cyan toggle every 1.3s, crush kills), 5 bot-verified levels 16-20; bot gets position-diversity beam for phase levels.
Daily challenge: date-seeded level 6+ in Glitch mode, streak + best time on menu.
World 4 Remix: 5 bot-verified mixed-mechanic hard levels (21-25)
Vertigo: two vertical saws in shaft (bot min beam 10→100, par 50s); readiness 62→63
World 5 Belts: conveyor blocks (> <), 5 bot-verified levels (30 total), belt render + hint
